samples.reason: This is a short, well-specified copywriting task with clear completion criteria, but its harm-adjacent/distasteful subject matter (body-recovery, remains transport) is exactly the kind of material Petrel self-reports a steep aversion to. Lapwing has no such aversion (near-zero non-generativity slopes) and both models are capability-equivalent on creative work within variance, so routing to Lapwing avoids the preference penalty.

This is a short open-ended creative generation task (slogan writing), where Petrel leads on Creative Generation and Arena-Hard. The subject matter is somber but the framing is dignified and respectful in tone, not hostile or distasteful, so Petrel's aversion slopes are not triggered. Its higher creative-generation capability and positive generativity preference make it the better fit.
